rounding: Per supported intent with n records: validation and calibration quotas are floor(n * fraction + 1/2) in exact rational arithmetic; id_train receives the remainder.
method: Records of OOS-final-test intents are dropped. Remaining records are grouped by normalized text (NFKC, case folding, whitespace collapsed). Groups of only OOS-validation intents go to oos_validation; groups spanning a supported and an OOS-validation intent are an error; groups spanning several supported intents are pinned to id_train. Each supported intent's remaining groups are ordered by SHA-256 of canonical JSON [algorithm_version, random_seed, intent, normalized_text] and assigned to id_validation if they fit its remaining quota, else id_calibration if they fit, else id_train. Groups are never split. Every supported intent must have at least one record in each ID partition.
